name: Nightmare Hunter Galaxy
description:
About This Game

Hunt Nightmares, explore Vibrant Worlds, and save the Galaxy in this challenging and precise roguelike. 

Explore randomly generated levels, collect 25+ powerful items, and test your skills in fast-paced combat.     

Game Features

  • Easy to learn, difficult to master 2.5D combat

  • Stylized pixel art graphics

  • Unique type-based item system

  • 4 Enemy Types

  • 1 Boss

Coming Soon!

  • More worlds to explore

  • More items, types & tiers

  • New Bosses & Enemies

  • NPCS, Cutscenes, and Story
